subject: Liveflip: observability sample, acceptance criteria & bridge closure
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>, ACME Ops <ops@acmepay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T15:15:00Z
Subject: Liveflip: observability sample, acceptance criteria & bridge closure

Hi Samantha / ACME Ops team,

We hit the planned "liveflip" activation window this morning and completed the initial traffic cutover per the runbook. To close the activation bridge I need a short acceptance window where ACME confirms:

- Observability sanity (errors, latency P95/P99, request volume distribution) looks normal for 30 minutes.
- No functional regressions from a small sample of customer-critical flows (tokenization, auth, data routing).

Attached: post-deploy-runbook.pdf (full checklist). Also attaching a small query list to reproduce the sample checks: acceptance-sample-query-list.txt.

Suggested next steps for ACME:
1) Run the sample queries (we included IDs in the query-list).
2) Review the Grafana panels linked below for any anomalous spikes.
3) Reply with PASS / FAIL and any findings. If PASS, we'll close the bridge at the agreed closure time (see below).

We plan to close the activation bridge at 16:30 UTC if you confirm PASS by 16:15 UTC. If you need more time, reply with a timestamp for a follow-up check.

Links: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/abcd/liveflip (top-level), panel with tail samples: https://grafana.redwood-inference.internal/d/abcd/liveflip?panelId=5&from=now-15m

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Sales Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: post-deploy-runbook.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, ACME Ops <ops@acmepay.com>

Date: 2027-12-01T15:33:00Z
Subject: Re: Liveflip: observability sample, acceptance criteria & bridge closure

Thanks Tessa — got the runbook and the sample list. Quick Q: can you confirm which service tags we should watch for error-grouping in Grafana (we have several overlays running)? Also, wanted to confirm that the bridge can remain open if we see a minor alert — we'll want to validate root cause before a forced rollback.

We will start running the sample queries now and expect to have a PASS/FAIL by 16:00 UTC.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform SRE | Acme Payments
[ACME Ops monitoring: ops@acmepay.com]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Liveflip: observability sample, acceptance criteria & bridge closure

Samantha — good questions. For this flip please focus on the following tags/labels in Grafana:
- service=redwood-inference-public, route=/v1/generate, model_tag=liveflip-v2
- error_group: auth.fail, routing.timeout, model.decoder-exception

Quick checklist for the sampling run (copied from acceptance-sample-query-list.txt):
- Run queries QID: LF-1001, LF-1007, LF-1023 (these hit the payment-auth codepaths)
- Capture a 15-minute tail for latency P95/P99 and error_count (PromQL snippets in the attached query list)
- Check KV cache hit-rate for the flow (we expect >85% after warmup)

If you see only transient single-request errors but overall latency & success rate are fine, keep the bridge open and escalate to us with a sample request id — we'll triage. If you see sustained error-rate >1% or P99 > 1.5s for the payment-auth queries, declare FAIL and we'll enact rollback steps in the runbook.

Attaching the small text file with PromQL snippets and the sampling commands.

Laura Bennett
Principal Product Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: acceptance-sample-query-list.txt (text/plain)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>, ACME Ops <ops@acmepay.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Liveflip: observability sample, acceptance criteria & bridge closure

Quick smoke results from our side: ran the scripted smoke harness against the payment-auth subset (LF-1001, LF-1007, LF-1023) for a 20-minute window. Summary:
- Error count: 4 total (all single-request, different request ids), no correlated trace found.
- Latency: P95 = 240ms, P99 = 1.1s for the sample flows.
- KV cache hit-rate: 89% (within expected range).

I attached the raw export (post-deploy-smoke-results.csv). From infra health and model decode traces, there are no systemic anomalies. Recommendation: PASS. Suggest we keep the bridge open for an additional 15 minutes to let ACME run any final customer flows; if no new issues, close bridge at 16:40 UTC.

If ACME sees anything that looks like a repeatable failure, flag it immediately and we will jump the rollback playbook.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Platform Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: post-deploy-smoke-results.csv (text/csv)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmepay.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Ops <ops@acmepay.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T18:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Liveflip: observability sample, acceptance criteria & bridge closure

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. ACME confirmed PASS at 16:30 UTC (per Samantha's note, internal ops validated a sample set). Karthik's harness results look clean.

We will:
- Close the activation bridge at 16:45 UTC (15 minutes from Karthik's recommendation) and transition to steady-state routing.
- Retain all traces and logs for seven days in the retention bucket for postmortem if needed.
- Keep the rollback plan (runbook section 4) on hot standby until 20:00 UTC.

Action items assigned:
- Aditya: kick off the post-cutover telemetry export to the shared Drive folder (please include the runbook pass/fail matrix).
- Laura: run one final KV cache sweep and post a short confirmation note.
- Karthik: keep the smoke harness running at low frequency for 2 hrs and escalate on any regression.

Samantha / ACME Ops: thanks for validating quickly. If you see anything off in the next hour ping this thread or use the emergency paging channel.

Closing note: bridge closure recorded in the cutover log (internal). I'll update the long-form activation readout doc tomorrow with the sample graphs.

Thanks,
Tessa
Sr. Sales Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
[internal note: activation bridge closed at 16:45 UTC; logs archived to https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4-liveflip-acceptance]
